name: DafnyBench Verifier Repair
one_liner: Iterative synthesis of loop invariants and helper assertions in Dafny guided by Dafny verifier error messages.

loop.proposes: An LLM inserts loop invariants and assertions into a Dafny program while keeping the top-level specification intact.
loop.judged_by: The Dafny verifier checks whether the program verifies and returns its error message when it does not.
loop.steers: The Dafny error message is fed back for up to 10 attempts until the verifier accepts the proof.

headline_result: Verified 68% of the 782 ground-truth formal verification programs in DafnyBench via multi-turn compiler feedback.
caveat: A spec check must prevent the model from trivially satisfying the verifier by weakening `ensures` clauses or adding `assume false`.
beyond_harness_note: The Dafny deductive verifier enforces formal proof obligations across iterative invariant synthesis.

sources.title: DafnyBench: A Benchmark for Formal Software Verification (arXiv:2406.08467)

verification.notes: Checked against Loughridge et al., arXiv:2406.08467.
